items.title: [负面] This game is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ awesome, the gameplay is real...
items.summary:
This game is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ awesome, the gameplay is really cool, the artstyle and the character designs are really unique and also cool as ♥♥♥♥, the story is...extremely interesting if you're into the Cthulhu Mythos, but it's very badly translated.

So, why is this a negative review? 
Because in the single month i've played, i've seen as the game has gotten worse for no reason, and instead of any sort of fixes, the developer's response has been "ah, gomen oomf chan" and silence.
I was previously excited to take part in the endgame mode because it looked very neat and challenging, the literal next day after i first finished it, they decide to make it harder for whales, except, instead of adding extra difficulties for them; they make *less* difficulties but make all of them *a lot harder*, like *you need to have 4 extremely whaled out dudes that are also extremely meta to even think about clearing this* hard.
This is also the only one of these games i've played where they actively nerf characters, and i now understand why people rarely do it! 
They also made a JP server where they implemented god-awful changes for no reason that also make the game more whale-focused, and they're slowly bringing them to the global server, so that's awesome too.

This game is awesome and i really wish it could shine, but all my goodwill has been spent in the month or so i've played and i have 0 hope it'll get better with how incompetent the dev team is (specifically the producer, who keeps making god-awful community posts that show he has no idea why he keeps ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ up).
